name: Commercial Dairy Concentrate (20% CP)
provenance: Local grain merchant / feed cooperative invoice (Mandya, May 2026)
notes: Pelleted compounded feed for lactating dairy cattle. Price experienced an 17.86% inflation hike due to rising raw ingredient and freight costs.

name: Cracked Maize (Corn Grain)
notes: Highly digestible non-fiber carbohydrate source for rumen microbial energy. Rapid starch fermentation; excessive feeding without buffer risks subacute ruminal acidosis (SARA).

name: Cottonseed Cake (Decorticated)
notes: Traditional oilseed cake high in bypass protein and vegetable fat, aiding milk fat synthesis.

name: Groundnut Cake (Expeller)
notes: Premium vegetable protein source with high palatability; must be tested for aflatoxin contamination.

name: De-Oiled Rice Bran (DORB)
notes: Economical agro-industrial byproduct rich in phosphorus and digestible fiber. Lower energy density; suitable for cost dilution when combined with high-energy grains.

name: Green Fodder (Hybrid Napier CO-4)
provenance: On-farm irrigated fodder plot / local farmer co-op
notes: Succulent perennial green fodder providing rumen bulk, carotene, and hydration. As-fed water content is ~80%.

name: Dry Fodder (Paddy Straw)
notes: Basal structural roughage required for rumen cud-chewing and saliva buffering. High silica and lignin limit digestibility.

name: Corn Silage (Baled)
notes: Anaerobically fermented whole-crop maize providing palatable energy and digestible fiber. Excellent summer buffer when green fodder is scarce.

name: Commercial Mineral Mixture & Buffers
notes: Essential trace minerals (Zn, Cu, Co, Mn, I) plus sodium bicarbonate for rumen buffering against heat-induced respiratory alkalosis and acidosis.
